headlines.title: Accenture (ACN) Following WSIB Win Has An Undervalued Narrative To Defend
headlines.summary: Accenture (ACN) is back in focus after Ontario's Workplace Safety and Insurance Board reported that a multiyear, Accenture-led digital overhaul cut employer registration times from days to under ten minutes. Those wins with Ontario's WSIB and Mondelez come as Accenture's share price has pulled back 2.35% in the last day and 2.52% over the past week, following a sharp 30 day share price gain of 21.67% and a 90 day share price return of 41.46% that lifted momentum.

headlines.title: Accenture Stock Rallied 31.5% Since October 6. Is Cognizant Now the Better Buy?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAccenture (ACN) stock rallied approximately 31. 5% from October 6 to November 9, closing at $254.

headlines.title: Ontario's Workplace Safety and Insurance Board Cuts Employer Registration Time from Days to Minutes with Guidewire
headlines.summary: Ontario's Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) and Guidewire (NYSE: GWRE) today announced that WSIB has transformed its employer registration experience, reducing a process that once took between eight to ten business days to one that now takes under ten minutes. Marking a significant milestone in its multi-year digital-first modernization program, enabled by Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform, WSIB collaborated with Guidewire partner Accenture (NYSE: ACN) on the project.

description: Accenture plc provides consulting and managed services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers artificial intelligence and data; cloud consulting; cybersecurity consulting; digital engineering and manufacturing; ecosystem partners; emerging technology; finance and risk management consulting; infrastructure and capital projects; digital learning; supply chain consulting; technology consulting; sustainability consulting; and metaverse solutions, as well as customer services. The company also provides proprietary assets and platforms, such as GenWizard, SynOps and reinvention.AI to clients. It serves aerospace and defense, automotive, banking, capital markets, chemicals, communications and media, consumer goods and services, energy, health, high tech, industrial, insurance, life sciences, natural resources, private equity, public service, retail, software and platforms, travel, and utilities industries. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
